$comment: Registry of connected seller accounts. Keys here are the account keys used in each catalog item's `stores` map (catalog/schema.json). One platform can appear more than once - see ebay_store_a / ebay_store_b. Showcase copy: account names are placeholders and storefront URLs are removed.

ebay_store_b.notes: Separate eBay account/store from ebay_store_a, same platform adapter, needs its own OAuth token pair.

poshmark.notes: No official seller API - see docs/API_RESEARCH.md. get_listing/monitoring only, no automated write.

vinted.notes: No general public listing-management API - see docs/API_RESEARCH.md.

mercari.notes: No official seller API - see docs/API_RESEARCH.md.

walmart.notes: Requires completing Walmart's seller/API onboarding (docs/API_RESEARCH.md) before any endpoint works.

amazon.notes: Placeholder entry so the schema/UI can represent Amazon without requiring SP-API developer registration - flip to monitor_only or full once there's a storefront to connect.
